sources.title: Sportsbook Review 10-year NFL archive (dates, quarter scores, open/close spread, total, moneyline)
sources.used_for: Every market price and result in the backtests (2011-2021)
sources.verification: 2,956 raw rows -> 2,945 usable after the integrity gate. Field-level defects found and documented: 260 corrupted closing spreads, 259 corrupted closing totals, 4 implausible moneyline pairs, 10 neutral-site Super Bowls with no home team, 1 unresolvable 'New York' row. Nothing was imputed.

sources.title: Nevada Gaming Control Board Monthly Revenue Report, November 2025
sources.used_for: Observed sportsbook hold, including the parlay-card hold that motivates the parlay work
sources.verification: Figures recorded from a read of the report on 2026-11-01: statewide, all nonrestricted locations, Sports Pool win 8.02% for the month / 6.74% over twelve months; Sports-Football 9.19% / 6.14%; Sports-Mobile 7.17% / 6.41%; Sports Parlay Cards 45.14% for the month / 19.94% over twelve months. RE-CHECK 2026-11-02: the PDF could not be re-fetched from gaming.nv.gov or from the Internet Archive (the 48-page PDF returns no text to this environment), so the exact decimals are NOT independently re-verified here and are flagged for manual review. Independent trade coverage of the same report corroborates the order of magnitude (sportsbook hold 'nearly 8%', football 9.2%, parlays ~19%), not the decimals.

sources.title: How Our NFL Predictions Work (Elo specification: K=20, one-third regression, margin-of-victory multiplier)
sources.used_for: Structure and constants of the walk-forward Elo component
sources.verification: RE-CHECKED 2026-11-02 by the audit session. The live URL no longer resolves to the article: fivethirtyeight.com redirects to abcnews.com/politics (FiveThirtyEight was wound down in 2025). The archived capture of 2025-01-16 was read instead and confirms K = 20, the margin-of-victory multiplier ln(point diff + 1) x 2.2 / (0.001 x Elo diff + 2.2), and an end-of-season regression of one third toward a mean of 1505. This project's implementation regresses toward 1500 (a 5-point difference, disclosed on the Lines page); the points-per-Elo conversion is estimated from this project's own data and is not taken from any source.
